newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Direct foreign investment in S.Korea surges in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Direct foreign investment in S.Korea surges in Q1.

text.p: Direct foreign investment in South Korea was $2.124 billion in the first quarter, up 372 percent from $450 million a year ago, the Ministry of Finance and Economy said on Monday.
Investment in manufacturing hit $907 million, up from $193 million, while non-manufacturing investment surged to $1.22 billion from $257 million, the ministry statement said.
The United States was the largest investor with $838 million against $94 million. Investment from the European Union rose to $696 million from $228 million.
The statement said streamlined investment rules and more open markets were behind the sharp increase.
